player_prompt.intro:
Nanhte Slitherlink {R}x{C} grid de sa wa na!
Makawk shani shagrai loop sa wa na, shani htingbu hku number nna shani htingbu hpe gaw shani grai hku nna re.
Htingbu hpe pawt shangun:
  [h r c] - htingbu u hku hpe pawt shangun, r shang, c shang
  [v r c] - htingbu nni hku hpe pawt shangun, r shang, c shang
Htingbu hpe number nna shani grai hku nna re, '.' gaw shani n hkrai hku re.
Nanhte {max_turns} hkrai hku shang de sa wa na, puzzle hpe jawm shangun.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Mai ai lam hpe gaw [h row col] ya [v row col] law.

outcome.win: Hkrun lam langai sha hpe nang galaw wa ai. Sumru sumhting hparan lu sai!
outcome.turn_limit: Shamu shamawt ai lam htum sai. Sumla hpe n ngut kre shi ai.
